title: SitecoreAI CLI Root Configuration
description: Defines the Sitecore AI CLI root configuration

defaultEnvProfile.description: Default environment profile to fetch or push data to

envProfiles.description: Named environment profiles used by this CLI

recipes.description: Globs locating .recipe.ts / .recipe.json files for `scai recipe compile|plan|push`. Defaults to `recipes/**/*.recipe.ts` if unset.

aiSkills.description: Sitecore AI Skills credentials (Brand Management, Brand Review, Documents, Pipeline), keyed by Sitecore organizationId. AI APIs keys are one-org-per-credential and use scopes separate from the Pages/Sites automation client.

defaultMaxRelativeItemPathLength.description:
Max relative item path length to serialize before considering path too long (and requiring aliasing to shorten).
Overridable on a per-module basis; this is the default when it is unspecified.

defaultModuleRelativeSerializationPath.description:
The default relative physical path from a module file where serialized items for that module will be stored.
For example given module /c/foo/bar.module.json, and default '/serialization/items' path,
the serialized items for bar would be stored at /c/foo/bar/serialization/items.
Prefix the path with ~/ for a root configuration relative path instead of a module-relative path.
Use '$(module)' to insert the module name when using a root relative path.
Overridable on a per-module basis; this is the default when it is unspecified.

removeOrphansForRoles.description: Specifies remove orphans functionality for roles serialization

removeOrphansForUsers.description: Specifies remove orphans functionality for users serialization

continueOnItemFailure.description: Specifies behavior when item synchronization fails

clientId.description: Client ID of the AI APIs key created in Cloud Portal → Stream → Admin → AI APIs keys. The matching secret lives in the OS keychain, never on disk.

audience.description: OAuth audience to request. Defaults to https://api.sitecorecloud.io.

tokenExpiresIn.description: Last-known expires_in (seconds) of the cached access token. Advisory only — actual cached token lives in the keychain.

tokenLastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last token mint. Advisory only.

telemetryEnabled.description: Determines if telemetry is enabled in cli.

cacheAuthenticationToken.description: Determines if the CLI should cache CM access/refresh tokens in the OS keychain.

versionComparisonEnabled.description: Determines if CLI\SMS version comparison is enabled.

apiClientTimeoutInMinutes.description: Determines timeout for Sitecore Api client.

EnvironmentConfiguration.description: Configures a named Sitecore environment profile

name.description: Optional display name for the environment

ref.description: Name of the environment to inherit from

allowWrite.description: Whether writing data to this endpoint is allowed (i.e. to prevent accidental writes to production)

host.description: Base URL to the Sitecore instance to connect to (i.e. http://{my-sitecore-instance}.sitecorecloud.io)

authority.description: Base URL to SitecoreAI identity authority (e.g. https://auth.sitecorecloud.io)

useClientCredentials.description: If true, use client credentials (client ID and secret) instead of interactive device login. Recommended for CI.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for this endpoint. Cached in the OS keychain when enabled.

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for this endpoint. Cached in the OS keychain when enabled.

refreshTokenParameters.description: OAuth refresh parameters for this endpoint (set manually if needed)

expiresIn.description: Preserves access token lifetime. Set during the login operation. Related to LastUpdated property. System use only.

lastUpdated.description: Preserve date and time when environment was updated. System use only.

deployToken.description: SitecoreAI access token (Deploy + CM/admin scopes). Cached in the OS keychain.

deployTokenLastUpdated.description: Last time the deploy token was updated

editingHostEnvironmentIds.description: Editing host environment IDs associated with this CM environment

clientId.description: OAuth client ID for this endpoint

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret for this endpoint (when useClientCredentials is true). Prefer environment variables.

variables.description: Defines variables that are specific to this environment. Variables defined here override any definitions in the root configuration for this environment.

audience.description: The unique identifier of the audience for an issued token

templatesRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates template items (e.g. /sitecore/templates/Project/<site>/Components). Tenant-specific. Used as fallback when --templates-root is not passed.

componentsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates component template items in the per-site folder layout (`<componentsRoot>/<section>/<Component>`). When unset, the compiler falls back to `templatesRoot` and emits the legacy flat layout. Used as fallback when --components-root is not passed.

contentModelsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates content-template items (`<contentModelsRoot>/<group>/<name>` when grouped, flat otherwise). When unset, content templates fall back to `templatesRoot` and land mixed in with components. Used as fallback when --content-models-root is not passed.

renderingsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates rendering items (e.g. /sitecore/layout/Renderings/Project/<site>). Tenant-specific. Used as fallback when --renderings-root is not passed.

partialDesignsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates partial-design items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Presentation/Partial Designs). Required for PartialDesignRecipe compilation.

pageDesignsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates page-design items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Presentation/Page Designs). Required for PageDesignRecipe compilation; also seeds crossRecipeRefs for the cross-recipe TemplatesMapping aggregate.

contentItemsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates shared content items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Data). Required for ContentItemRecipe compilation.

headlessVariantsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates SXA Headless rendering variants (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Headless Variants). Required when any recipe in the set declares variants.

availableRenderingsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates SXA Available Renderings section items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Available Renderings). One section per `recipe.section` is emitted with all renderings in that section listed in the Renderings field.

enumerationsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai recipe compile|push` creates EnumerationRecipe items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Enumerations). Each enum lands as `<enumerationsRoot>/<EnumName>` with one child item per declared value. Required for EnumerationRecipe compilation, and for any recipe whose fields carry `sitecore.enumHandle`.

placeholderSettingsRoots.description: Sitecore content-tree paths to walk when resolving recipe-declared `placeholders` to Placeholder Settings items (matched by their `Placeholder Key` field). Typically the per-site Presentation/Placeholder Settings AND the Layout/Placeholder Settings/Project/<site> path.

recipeRoots.description: Preferred nested form of the *Root fields. Flattened into the matching flat fields at config-load time (recipeRoots wins when both are set; a warning fires).
